closed_gaps.note: Raw CPR and identity document numbers are no longer serialized in public display outputs.
Checksum and revision-friendly DTO fields exist, but backend revision lineage is still incomplete.
Modern render failures can be persisted to a local JSONL log.

open_gaps.note: Per-field authoritative revision and conflict-apply semantics are not implemented.
12 backend test failures remain tied to missing reference workbook assets and stale tests.
Public display privacy is improved, but token delivery remains the access model.
Desktop diagnostics are stored locally only; no support bundle export exists yet.
